links.comparator_used: Single unaveraged MLLM response per photograph / individual repeated queries from the same model
links.outcome: Burn extent estimation error from repeated MLLM assessments
links.effect: Averaging the five answers reduced error by only 0.24-2.22 pp; median within-image range across repeated queries was 5.0-25.0 pp.
links.tradeoff: The larger systematic error persisted and required calibration against reference data before clinical use.
links.quote: Across repeated queries, the median within-image range was 5.0-25.0 pp; averaging the five answers reduced error by only 0.24-2.22 pp.
